text_markup: The Runner runs into a rezzed {card:Wormhole}. The only other piece of ice that is rezzed is a {card:Wormhole}, and so a mandatory infinite loop is created where each of the {card:Wormhole}s' subroutines resolves the other. The Corp chooses how many times this loop occurs, say 2,157 times, and then the Runner continues the run.
text_plain: The Runner runs into a rezzed Wormhole. The Corp chooses how many times this loop occurs, say 2,157 times, and then the Runner continues the run.
